name: karino
description: Karino is a full-stack productivity platform with an Express API and a Next.js client.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
